Commands:
  /remember - remember right away (/remember text; or just start a sentence with "remember that...")
  /import   - add a file to memory: a table or a document (/import path/to/file.xlsx)
  /review   - go through suggestions for memory and audit questions
  /agreements - agreements: view, mark done, add
  /checkin  - three short questions about what's going on now (the coach learns the present)
  /people   - people from the notes: who they are, whether they're in your life now
  /calibrate - which old notes are still true now: questions, checking against your biography
  /focus    - presence mode: you work, and the coach is nearby and now and then writes briefly on its own
              (/focus what I'm doing; or "stay with me, I'm sitting down to write the report"). To turn off: /focus, "stop", "done".
              Optional: a registry item and a plan - /focus LR-12 for 50 minutes draft
  /forget   - find and forget a wrong statement (/forget text)
  /think    - reasoning: think harder, but slower (/think - on/off for the conversation; /think question - for this question only).
              Works while the model runs on the PC's graphics card
  Life Reset - going through what has built up over the years:
  /reset    - program overview: stage, what has been reviewed, what can be done now (quick, normal, deep)
  /triage   - go through the registry one item at a time (/triage 5 - five at a time; /triage finance - one area;
              /triage quick - as a list: "1a 2s 3l", "4?" - as a card)
  /sweep    - single mentions in a batch: mark the live ones, archive the rest
  /audit    - life audit: 12 areas, one line each
  /hypotheses - check hypotheses about recurring scenarios
  /idea     - write a new idea into the registry without making it a project right away (/idea text)
  /depth    - depth of the conversation: 1 practical, 2 analytical, 3 deep reflection (/depth 3)
  /bio      - life timeline by year from the database, without the model (/bio 1988-2026; --all - everything in order; /history - same;
              or "print everything from the database by year")
  /sources  - where the memory for the last answer came from
  /new      - finish this session and start a new one
  /exit     - exit (the session summary is saved)
Everything else - conversation.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (
  path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

  size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
  mtime REAL NOT NULL,
  note_date TEXT,
  date_source TEXT NOT NULL,
  tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  links_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  status TEXT NOT NULL,              -- indexed | security_hold | stale
  hold_reason TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS chunks (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  path TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes(path) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  idx INTEGER NOT NULL,
  char_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
  char_end INTEGER NOT NULL,
  line_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
  line_end INTEGER NOT NULL,
  heading TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  chunk_date TEXT,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',   -- pending | done | imported | error
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  error TEXT,
  embedding BLOB,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(path, idx)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunks_status ON chunks(status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_chunks_sha ON chunks(sha256);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS facts (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  chunk_id INTEGER REFERENCES chunks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  path TEXT,                          -- NULL for facts from dialogue
  source_ref TEXT NOT NULL,           -- path#Lx-Ly or session:N
  origin TEXT NOT NULL,               -- note | v3_import | chat | session
  claim TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  domain TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'self',
  explicitness TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'explicit',
  intent_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',
  event_date TEXT,                    -- when it happened (from the text or the note date)
  note_date TEXT,
  date_reliable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  evidence_quote TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  quote_match TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',   -- exact | partial | none
  sensitivity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal',
  is_project INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  user_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none',    -- none | confirmed | rejected
  cluster_id INTEGER,
  embedding BLOB,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_facts_path ON facts(path);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_facts_cluster ON facts(cluster_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_facts_chunk ON facts(chunk_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hypotheses_raw (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  chunk_id INTEGER REFERENCES chunks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  path TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
  hypothesis TEXT NOT NULL,
  evidence_quote TEXT NOT NULL,
  alternative TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hyp_chunk ON hypotheses_raw(chunk_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hyp_path ON hypotheses_raw(path);

  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  domain TEXT NOT NULL,
  centroid BLOB,
  size INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  support_notes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  first_date TEXT,
  last_date TEXT,
  head_fact_id INTEGER,              -- the most recent reliable fact of the cluster
  score REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Synthesis results (domains, profile, audit) with an input fingerprint for the cache.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS artifacts (
  stage TEXT NOT NULL,
  key TEXT NOT NULL,
  fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY(stage, key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  ended_at TEXT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  agreements_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  embedding BLOB
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS turns (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role TEXT NOT NULL,                -- user | assistant
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  refs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Memory suggestions from dialogues and audit questions: waiting for the user's decision.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS candidates (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  session_id INTEGER,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,              -- chat | audit
  claim TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  domain TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other',
  reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  target_fact_id INTEGER,            -- for audit questions: which fact it is about
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',   -- pending | accepted | rejected | skipped
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  decided_at TEXT
);

-- The user's decisions on claims (confirmed / rejected). Stored separately from
-- facts, so they survive re-extraction of notes: new facts close
-- in meaning get the same mark.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_marks (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  claim TEXT NOT NULL,
  mark TEXT NOT NULL,                -- confirmed | rejected
  embedding BLOB,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Agreements from conversations: what the person decided to do, with a deadline and status.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS commitments (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  session_id INTEGER,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  due TEXT,                          -- deadline, if mentioned (YYYY-MM-DD)
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',   -- open | done | dropped
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',     -- how it is going, why it was dropped
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_commitments_status ON commitments(status);

-- Check-in: short answers to "how are you / what matters most / what gets in the way" (in their own words).
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS checkins (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  mood INTEGER,                      -- 1..10, if given
  answers_json TEXT NOT NULL,        -- {"mood": "...", "focus": "...", "worry": "..."}
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- People from notes and answers. A row lives by name and survives re-extraction:
-- your answers (who this is, whether they are in your life now) are not lost; links to facts are rebuilt.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS people (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  relation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  relation_src TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   -- model | user
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',  -- current | past | unknown | ignored (not a person / error)
  until TEXT,                              -- for past: roughly when
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  merged_into INTEGER,                     -- this is the same person as people.id
  mentions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  first_date TEXT,
  last_date TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_people_name ON people(name COLLATE NOCASE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_people (
  fact_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  person_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (fact_id, person_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fact_people_person ON fact_people(person_id);

-- Presence mode (body double): what and how long the person worked with the coach "alongside".
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS focus_sessions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  session_id INTEGER,
  task TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  ended_at TEXT,
  minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

-- Quality review: your verdicts on a sample. Stores the item key, not the text itself,
-- so the report consists only of numbers and can be forwarded.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS eval_marks (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  target TEXT NOT NULL,              -- currency | fact | profile | reply
  item_key TEXT NOT NULL,            -- item hash: one item is not shown twice
  breakdown TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',-- report breakdown: profile section, currency source, fact type
  verdict TEXT NOT NULL,
  version TEXT NOT NULL,             -- code / prompt / model version
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_eval_target ON eval_marks(target, item_key);

-- Currency: what in memory is true now and what was true before. Decisions are stored by wording
-- (like user_marks) and survive re-extraction of notes.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS currency_marks (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  claim TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL,              -- current | past
  until TEXT,                        -- roughly when it ended (for past)
  period TEXT,                       -- when it was, if known ("2012-2016")
  source TEXT NOT NULL,              -- user - the person's answer; timeline - check against biography and answers
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  embedding BLOB,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Life Reset: registry of accumulated items. An item lives by meaning (title + essence + vector) and
-- survives re-extraction of notes: on `inventory build` new groups of facts
-- are matched to items by vector, and status and decision history are not lost.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lr_items (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  type TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- commitment | project | idea | wish | question | situation | routine | material | experience
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inbox',
  domain TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other',
  summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  want TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',      -- original desire: what was wanted back then
  hint TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',      -- what memory shows (by code): "marked as done in the notes"
  origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'memory',   -- memory | chat
  sensitive INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  first_date TEXT,
  last_date TEXT,                     -- last mention in notes and conversations
  mentions INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  notes_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  next_step TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  review_on TEXT,                     -- when to review (someday / incubating / waiting)
  touched TEXT,                       -- when the source note file last changed (for notes without dates)
  resurfaced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   -- a closed item reappeared in the notes
  src_sig TEXT,                       -- fingerprint of the source project notes at the time of the decision
  merged_into INTEGER,
  fact_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  paths_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  anchors_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',  -- "note:path": a project note always maps to this item, whatever it is called
  embedding BLOB,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  decided_at TEXT
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lr_items_status ON lr_items(status);

-- Decision log: initial state, the coach's proposal, the person's decision and reason.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lr_decisions (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  item_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
  from_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_status TEXT NOT NULL,
  proposal TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',  -- what the coach proposed (if it proposed)
  answer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',    -- the person's answer in their own words
  reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lr_decisions_item ON lr_decisions(item_id);

-- Life audit by areas: one round, one date, one row per area.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lr_audit (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  round INTEGER NOT NULL,
  area TEXT NOT NULL,
  satisfaction INTEGER,               -- 1..10: how satisfied with it now
  importance INTEGER,                 -- 1..10: how important it is
  change TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',    -- yes | no | maybe: whether they want to change it
  nature TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',    -- problem | should | '': a real problem or "it should be this way"
  note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(round, area)
);

-- Psychological hypotheses: not facts and not diagnoses. A confirmed one is a description
-- of a recurring pattern that the person acknowledged, not a personality trait.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lr_hypotheses (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  observations_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',   -- [{"quote", "ref", "date"}]
  alternatives_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  question TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',  -- question to check
  confidence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'low',          -- low | medium | high
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',              -- new | testing | pattern | rejected
  user_note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  embedding BLOB,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  checked_at TEXT
);
